name: Sam trung nuong
summary: Sam trứng nướng is horseshoe crab grilled on charcoal, then shredded with its eggs, spring onion, garlic, chili, cilantro, and crushed peanuts. The eggs are fatty and the meat is sweet.
howToEat: Grill, then shred and mix. The story calls the eggs fatty and the meat sweet, and says crab and ghẹ do not match it.
seoTitle: Sam trung nuong — grilled horseshoe crab in Can Gio
seoDescription: Sam trứng nướng is horseshoe crab grilled and shredded with fatty eggs and sweet meat.
taste: Fatty eggs and sweet meat, with spring onion, garlic, chili, cilantro, and peanuts.
